name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: TEST BUILD (branch test-branch-udp-connection). Direct links: an encrypted UDP connection straight between your server and a friend's, opened through both home routers without port forwarding (like Tailscale, built in). Your viewers at home get a friend's video over it at your two homes' real speeds, even when the friend's server is only reachable through a slow tunnel or VPS; viewers elsewhere keep going straight to the friend, so your upload is never used for friend video. Library downloads from a friend also use it. Both servers need 0.0.195; Linux servers (x64/arm64), Windows later. Status per friend on the Friends tab, switch in Advanced, and a Direct link row in Playback Info. Security: keys pinned per session over the existing https friend channel, mutual TLS 1.3 (QUIC), only the friend's video, download and speed-test routes are carried, with the same token checks as today and your remote-access/IP rules applied to the friend's address. Includes everything in 0.0.194.
